postconditions.description: The number of flowers is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of subarrays suggested by the mother is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The mood of each flower is between -100 and 100, inclusive.
Each subarray is described by a pair of integers l_i and r_i, where l_i is the start and r_i is the end of the subarray, both inclusive.
